public_rationale: The ARC Prize Foundation runs a leading AGI benchmark. In December 2025 it asked 'do we have AGI?' and answered 'Not yet.' In January 2026, Elon Musk still described AI smarter than any human as a future goal, for the end of 2026. That shows it had not arrived. Musk had made the same kind of promise in April 2024, when he said AGI would come 'probably next year.' That date passed without AGI. So both parts hold: AGI had not come by February 2026, and at least one prominent industry leader kept repeating the promise with later dates.
limitations: AGI is loosely defined; the judgment relies on a benchmark organisation's view.
The 'year after year' part is shown for Musk only; the claim's 'they' is broader.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As of February 2026, AGI has not arrived, despite AI industry leaders repeating the promise year after year.

statement.excerpt: Well, AGI still hasn’t come (even though they keep issuing the same promises, year after year).
statement.document_title: BREAKING: LLM “reasoning” continues to be deeply flawed

from_speaker: they keep issuing the same promises
our_interpretation: Plain reading: as of the post date (2026-02-10), no AI system was widely recognised as AGI.

Plain reading of 'they keep issuing the same promises, year after year': prominent industry leaders publicly predicted near-term AGI or superhuman AI in more than one year, and the earlier predictions did not come true by their own dates.
criteria.support_condition: Credible sources from late 2025 to early 2026 say AGI has not been reached. Dated statements show an industry leader predicting near-term AGI in at least two different years, with the earlier deadline passing unmet.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A system widely recognised as AGI existed by February 2026, or no prominent industry leader made repeated near-term AGI promises.

evidence.explanation: A leading AGI benchmark organisation said in December 2025 that AGI had not been reached. This supports 'AGI still hasn't come.'

evidence.excerpt: “If you define AGI (artificial general intelligence) as smarter than the smartest human, I think it’s probably next year, within two years,” Musk said
evidence.explanation: In April 2024 Musk promised AGI 'probably next year', meaning 2025. This is one of the earlier promises the claim refers to.

evidence.excerpt: Musk also predicted the artificial intelligence boom will have models that are "smarter than any human by the end of this year, and I would say no later than next year."
evidence.explanation: In January 2026 Musk again put smarter-than-any-human AI in the future, at the end of 2026. This implies it had not arrived, and it repeats his 2024 promise with a later date.
